items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: Roy Cicala was the owner of Record Plant... he pulled me in, and he always had a band that he was working with... he brought me into a session

ctx.x: So I got to do a lot of that, and, backtracking a little, I’d been working for free, learning all this stuff from the assistants, and people there, and all of a sudden when I walked in one day they go, “Roy wants to work with you.” And Roy Cicala was the owner of Record Plant. He was John Lennon’s engineer. He goes way, way back. He’s just an amazing, amazing engineer. And so he pulled me in, and he always had a band that he was working with, kind of a pet project and also for training people. And so he brought…
Was that his way of like testing you to see if you knew what you were doing?
